reviews.author: Jose Vargas
reviews.text: I would advise everyone to stay as far away from this company as possible. They have shown a complete lack of respect for property and basic professional ethics. • Repeat Property Damage: During a snowstorm last month, this company plowed a massive amount of snow directly into my fence (which is only 3 years old), causing damage. A police report was filed at that time. • Zero Accountability: Despite the previous incident and police involvement, they returned during the next storm and did the exact same thing, damaging my fence for a second time. • Dangerous & Aggressive Behavior: When I attempted to bring the damage to the driver’s attention, he backed his vehicle up so recklessly he nearly hit me with the plow. • Unprofessional Conduct: After walking over to look at the damage, the driver dismissively tapped me on the shoulder and said, “Have a good day,” without offering any resolution or apology for the destruction of my property. This isn't just "bad service", it is a total disregard for safety and neighborly conduct. If you value your property (or your nerves), do not hire them. They are unprofessional, dismissive, and their work style is destructive. If 0 stars was an option, I would have chosen that.

reviews.author: Jennifer Ward
reviews.text: Expert tree removal. The entire crew did a great job. Jose the owner is professional and fair from the initial estimate to checking the completion of job. These guys are the best !

reviews.author: Jennifer Carloni
reviews.text: Jose and his crew were wonderful to work with. Their estimate was far below their competitors and I hired them on the spot. They took the time to make sure that their equipment would not damage my property and were flexible with my situation. They were also neat and cleaned up all debris that was left after the tree was cut down. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: William Charschan
reviews.text: Just finished my home where I needed three trees removed including a large one and some tree trimming. They were professional, on time, great communicators, neat and extremely well priced. I plan to use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Fred Harris
reviews.text: Phenomenal work! We had 5 very mature trees removed and stumps ground. It was a very big job and they were professional, reliable, efficient and we were amazed at how hard they work! This is the second time we have used JCR and the referrals we made were also pleased with their work! Thank you Jose!

reviews.author: Michael Saraceno
reviews.text: Jose from JCR quoted us fairly and his crew did a great job clearing a giant fallen Ash tree from my back yard. I am very happy with the quality and timeliness of the job JCR did. Would definitely recommend their services!

reviews.author: Brian Gackstatter
reviews.text: Great Service. Took Down a Huge Tree without any problems. Tree was in a tricky spot with lots of overhead power lines. Very professional crew and state of the art equipment. Would highly recommend for any tree removal.

reviews.author: Donna Fountain
reviews.text: JCR is a plus five in professional tree service. The owner is responsible. His team were courteous and respectful of my property and left the site clean. I gladly agreed to have the JCR sign on my lawn. I will definitely re-hire them.

reviews.author: Tom Kelly
reviews.text: Excellent service start to finish. Large tree removal that did not have easy access. The crew worked quickly without any issues. Thorough clean up afterwards.

reviews.author: Larry B
reviews.text: Great work and good price. They removed five very large ash trees in one day. Left the area cleaner then when they arrived.

reviews.author: Doreen Carrie
reviews.text: Jose and his crew did 4 houses on our street and all were done incredibly well...so professional and so responsive to our every need...cleaned all debris spotlessly We will recommend highly!
